custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a custom role from before this release, role A, whose name contains the word Catalog.
  • Have a part from before this release, part A, whose description contains the word Catalog.
  • Start on Roles & Permissions (click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu).

Setup

  1. Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, and look in the Role Name column for a name with the word Catalog.
  2. On the Inventory page click Search and type Catalog.
